issue.title: Four non-visual facades lack __test__ = False so their tests run twice

task_type_fields.impact: Doubled test collection wastes time and risks duplicate-path errors of the kind fixed in the four visual facades.
task_type_fields.repro: Run pytest --collect-only on any of the four facades and count: each split test is collected twice. Only add __test__ = False after verifying the facade is not the sole collection point for _-prefixed split modules.

issue.creation_reason: Found during green_master_ci_repair: four non-visual facades re-export split tests without the repo-standard __test__ = False, doubling collection.
